belizaire-and-the-frey-children

Three white children sit with a young Black boy named Bélizaire, an enslaved child who was part of their household in New Orleans. Jacques Amans painted this in 1837. Today the painting is studied for what it shows about slavery in America, because Bélizaire is one of few enslaved children painted by name. It reminds us that art can record difficult parts of history.
street-singer

A woman in a light-colored dress steps out of a cheap Paris café, holding a guitar and eating cherries, with a thoughtful look. Manet saw a real street singer and asked her to pose in his studio. He treated her with the same dignity as a society lady. It's a famous picture of everyday life in Paris.
lola-de-valence

A Spanish dancer in a glittering, spangled skirt strikes a proud pose. Manet painted Lola Melea when she came to Paris with a Spanish troupe in 1862. The sparkling outfit and bold stance are eye-catching. The poet Baudelaire wrote a verse for the frame.
portrait-of-monsieur-and-madame-auguste-manet

The artist's parents sit stiffly in a dark room, his father in a chair and his mother at a table with her sewing. Manet painted them early in his career, with deep care. The calm, serious faces reveal their characters. It's a quiet and moving family portrait.
the-bridge-at-narni

An ancient Roman bridge with a broken arch crosses a gorge, in clean sunlight with a hill town above. Corot painted it on the spot in Italy, as a young artist. The solid shapes and gentle light are remarkable. It's one of the most admired landscape sketches of the 1800s.
by-the-seashore

A young woman in a straw hat and a blue dress sits on a rocky coast, her hands in her lap, with a soft smile. Renoir painted her at the beach in Guernsey, in a gentle, feathery style. The warm tones glow. It's one of his best portraits.
nocturne-blue-and-gold-old-battersea-bridge

A long wooden bridge rises as a shadowy silhouette in the dusk, with fireworks and a tiny boat below. Whistler was inspired by Japanese prints and used simple shapes and subtle tones. He painted the London night like a piece of music. It's a famous atmospheric painting.
goethe-in-the-roman-campagna

The great German writer Goethe reclines in a traveler's cloak and a wide hat, by a ruin in the Italian countryside. Tischbein painted his friend during their trip to Italy. The pose looks like an ancient hero. It's the most famous portrait of Goethe.
the-icebergs

A massive iceberg rises from a cold, calm sea, with a ship's broken mast lying in the foreground. Church sailed to the Arctic to sketch the real ice. When shown in New York, people paid to see this panorama. It's one of the most spectacular polar landscapes.
peace-concluded

A British officer sits in a chair, his wife leaning on him, while their children hold a toy and look at a newspaper announcing the end of the Crimean War. Millais painted a family's joy at the end of a war. The details of uniforms and toys are lovingly done. It's a heartfelt homecoming.
the-return-of-the-dove-to-the-ark

Two of Noah's sons gently hold a dove that has returned with an olive branch, a sign that the Flood is ending. Millais used a vivid red and green. The picture is bright with hope. It's a famous Pre-Raphaelite painting of a Bible story.
the-black-duchess

A beautiful woman in a black dress points to her ring, which bears Goya's name, as a wry reminder of the artist's skill. The Duchess of Alba was one of Spain's grandest ladies. Goya's portrait of her is powerful and playful. It's a famous mystery of art history.
self-portrait-with-palette

Manet stands with his palette and brushes in a pale suit and a hat, looking out calmly. This is his only full-length self-portrait, and the style is elegant and cool. He painted it near the end of his life. It's a very stylish portrait.
spring-lawrence-alm

A procession of women in colorful robes, with flowers, move along a marble street in an ancient festival, with the blue sea in the distance. Alma-Tadema loved to paint the warm Mediterranean world. The scene is rich in details. It's a bright vision of spring in the ancient world.
portrait-of-count-stanislas-potocki
A Polish nobleman rides a rearing white horse in a fine uniform, in a heroic pose. David painted the portrait in Rome. The dramatic composition shows his skill. It's a spirited portrait.
the-agnew-clinic

A surgeon performs an operation in a medical amphitheater, as students lean in to watch. Eakins painted Dr. Hayes Agnew, who has just finished teaching his last class. The picture is clean and well-lit, in contrast with his earlier, darker Gross Clinic. It shows how medicine had changed.
the-ray

A skate fish hangs open on a hook, a cat arches its back at the sight, and oysters lie on a kitchen table. Chardin painted this at 28, and it won him membership in the French Academy. The colors, textures and shapes are magical. It's one of the greatest still lifes ever painted.
ukrainian-night

White huts glow in the moonlight by a stream, in a deep blue night under a starry sky. Kuindzhi painted the glowing moon so brightly that people thought there was a lamp behind it. The silvery light is magical. It's a favorite Ukrainian landscape.
argenteuil

A couple sits at the edge of a river in the sun, with sailboats and the town of Argenteuil in the background, in bright blue. Manet painted it outdoors in 1874, following the Impressionists. The colors are fresh and the mood is cheerful. It's one of his boldest paintings.
the-goose-girl

A young country girl with a stick stands barefoot with a flock of geese in a field. Bouguereau painted peasant girls in soft light. The smooth skin and bright colors are typical of his charm. It's a delightful and sweet picture.
two-old-men-eating-soup

Two old men in a dark room, one gaunt and one hunched over a bowl, with strange, shadowy faces. Goya painted this on a wall in his house. It is one of the 'Black Paintings' that he made for himself. It's a strange and powerful image.
portrait-de-madame-de-senonnes

A woman in a dark red velvet dress with a gold shawl sits in an elegant pose, her cheeks flushed, in front of a mirror. Ingres painted the fine details of fabrics, hair and jewelry. The critics found the picture odd at the time, but it's now admired. It's one of his greatest portraits.
boy-blowing-bubbles

A boy leans on a table, watching a bubble he's made, with a skull nearby that reminds us that life is short. Manet painted it as a 'vanitas,' a type of picture about how things are fragile. The boy is Léon Leenhoff, his stepson. It's a thoughtful picture about time.
claude-monet-painting-in-his-studio-boat

Monet sits on his floating studio, painting while his wife Camille sits in the cabin. Manet painted his friend at work on the river Seine at Argenteuil. They painted together in the open air. It's a picture of one great painter looking at another.
the-peacemakers

Near the end of the American Civil War, President Lincoln and three leaders meet on a steamship to discuss peace. Healy painted the scene a few years after, in a quiet cabin with a view of the sea. The painting honors the hope for peace. It hangs in the White House.
the-fight-between-mars-and-minerva

The god of war, Mars, battles the goddess of wisdom, Minerva, as Venus tries to help. David painted this as a student and won a prize in Paris. It's a lesson that wisdom defeats brute force. It's an early peek at his talent.
a-view-through-three-of-the-north-western-arches-of-the-thir

The huge stone arches of the Colosseum in Rome frame a sunlit view of the city. Eckersberg, a Danish painter, painted it on a visit to Italy. The light and the shadow on the stone are exact. It's a classic Danish painting.
a-pair-of-shoes

A pair of worn leather boots with muddy laces sits on the floor. Van Gogh painted several pictures of old boots, finding beauty in them. The philosopher Heidegger wrote about them. It's an ordinary thing that tells a story about a hard-working life.
count-lepic-and-his-daughters

A man in a hat strolls through Paris with two little girls and a dog, in a quick, candid scene. Degas painted Viscount Lepic, who was a friend and a fellow artist. It looks like a snapshot. It's a lively view of the city.
portrait-of-pope-pius-vii

The pope sits wearing a red cape, looking weary, and he rests his hands on a chair. David painted it in Paris before Napoleon's coronation. The face is full of character. It's among the best portraits of its day.
the-rescue

A fireman carries three small children out of a burning house, as the mother kneels in thankfulness. Millais painted the glowing flames. The painting was a favorite for its drama. It's a thrilling image of bravery.
the-dead-toreador
A bullfighter lies in the sand, in a black suit, shot in the ring. Manet cut a figure from a larger picture. The soft grays and blacks are painted with great skill. It's a quiet and striking picture.
evening-on-karl-johan

A crowd of people in dark clothes, with pale, mask-like faces, walks toward us along a main street in Oslo, with a single man going the other way. Munch painted the feeling of being alone in a crowd. The strange lights make it eerie. It's an early step toward his famous anxiety paintings.
the-port-of-greifswald

Ships rest at the harbor of Friedrich's hometown, with the town's church spires against a glowing sky. He painted his birthplace from memory. The sky is a soft, golden blue. It's a calm and lovely harbor view.
homage-to-delacroix

A group of artists and writers, including Manet and Whistler, gather around a portrait of the painter Delacroix. Fantin-Latour painted it to honor Delacroix, who had recently died. It's like a family photo. It shows who the leading artists of the day were.
consulting-the-oracle

Priestesses and visitors gather around a bronze bowl to hear a prophecy in an ancient Greek temple. Waterhouse studied ancient art to get the details right. The women lean in with awe. It's an atmospheric picture of ancient belief.
max-schmitt-in-a-single-scull

A rower glides across the Schuylkill River in Philadelphia in the early morning, as a tiny figure of the artist rows in the distance. Eakins painted his friend, who was a champion. The sunlight on the water is gorgeous. It's among the first great American sports paintings.
marie-antoinette-with-a-rose

The queen of France holds a rose in her hand in a simple dress and a straw hat, in a garden. Vigée Le Brun painted her as a lovely woman instead of a queen. The first version was shocking because it was so informal. It's a very charming portrait.
a-cotton-office-in-new-orleans

Men in a busy office examine samples of cotton, read newspapers and talk business. Degas painted the office of his uncle during a trip to New Orleans. It's an unusual picture of work. It's also a reminder that cotton was a huge industry that depended on enslaved labor before the Civil War.
maison-devant-la-sainte-victoire-pres-de-gardanne-house-in-p

A group of orange-roofed houses sits in front of the mountain in the south of France, in blocks of color. Cézanne painted the village of Gardanne, simplifying the buildings into cubes. Some people say this led to Cubism. It's a pioneering piece.
mr-and-mrs-edouard-manet

A man reads a newspaper in a chair as a woman sits at the piano, smiling gently. Degas painted his friend Manet and his wife Suzanne. Manet later cut a piece off the canvas because he didn't like how Suzanne looked, which upset Degas. It's a famous story.
the-bewitched-man

A nervous man in a theater looks out as a lamp holds a ghostly light, while a monster-like figure watches. Goya painted a comic scene to poke fun at superstitions. It's a spooky painting with a silly side. It's one of his best-known works.
the-circus-parade

A band of musicians plays on a platform in front of a circus, under the glowing yellow gas lights. Seurat painted tiny dots of color to capture the glimmer of the evening. The figures look as stiff as statues. It's a magical, strange picture.
death-and-the-woodcutter

An old woodcutter, bent under a heavy load, is startled by Death, who comes to take him. Millet based it on a fable by La Fontaine, in which the man changes his mind about wanting to die. The painting shows the hard life of a working man. It's a famous story told in paint.
le-pont-neuf

People hurry in all directions across the oldest bridge in Paris, under a cloud-filled sky. Renoir painted a crowd of cabs, walkers and umbrellas in tiny dabs of color. It's a lively snapshot. It's a fresh, early Impressionist city scene.
the-washington-family

George Washington, his wife Martha, and her grandchildren sit around a table with a map of the new capital city, with an enslaved servant at the side. Savage painted it in 1796 and it was widely copied as a print. The picture shows the nation's first family in their elegant home. It also reminds us that the Washingtons enslaved people.
